_comment: Postgres connection budget (docs/DECISIONS.md). Worst case = sum over services of max_instances x pools x pool_max, plus each job's connections. It must fit max_connections - reserved - operator_headroom; a Terraform precondition and tests/connection-budget.test.ts both enforce it. pool_max becomes the service's PG_POOL_MAX (a cap on every pool it opens). 'pools' is how many pools the service's code opens; the test checks it against the code.
